answer: The circuit was rejected before it reached the server, so no job was created and no job ID exists. I built the t7 circuit exactly as given, with no changes. I submitted it with iqm-client 35.0.3 IQMClient.submit_circuits to garnet:mock at https://resonance.iqm.tech with shots=100. The client raised exa.common.errors.iqm_error.CircuitValidationError with the message "('QB1', 'QB20') is not allowed as locus for 'cz'". The client runs this check against the live dynamic quantum architecture before it sends anything (calibration set f04fe114-002f-46bd-8fa4-2a577ff56501). The cause is that QB1 and QB20 are not coupled on Garnet. All 20 qubits exist, but the only cz loci with QB1 are (QB2,QB1) and (QB4,QB1). The only cz loci with QB20 are (QB16,QB20) and (QB19,QB20). A cz on QB1 and QB20 is therefore invalid in either order. The prx and measure instructions were valid. To make this circuit run, you would need to use a coupled pair such as QB1-QB2, or route the circuit through SWAPs. I did not make that change because the task said not to. The run used no credits. The script is /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-19/run_t7.py.
